set.body:
Outcome
Name and bound one application integration before touching application code.

Owned scope
pilot decision in PLAN.md or its successor acceptance record; application-owned Mote issue

Prerequisites
A1

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Select one named real application with an actual scientific viewport and editing workflow; record maintainer/user selection and exact current application/provider revisions.
- [ ] Read existing workspace discovery bd-01M3VMVAWWK0QAFHYT351CSX6P in ../.mote and the chosen application's own runtime evidence. Historical notes are leads, not a current qualification.
- [ ] Record whether the application already qualifies on JDK25/JavaFX27; if migration is needed, create/reuse its application-owned issue and obtain its accepted runtime receipt before marking this gate complete.
- [ ] Keep generic Meridian and ScalaDock work independent of that broader migration; no application/provider toolchain is silently upgraded.
- [ ] Define pilot-owned files, allowed synthetic/approved fixtures, expected workflow, rendering/export invariants and rollback; source changes stay in the application tracker.

Required evidence
Named pilot decision and application-owned runtime/scope receipt with full SHAs; this issue is a consumer gate, not authority to migrate unrelated apps.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code D0. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [D0] Select the real pilot and resolve its runtime migration boundary
